dependency_graph.common_rule: VALID once asserted MUST remain asserted until READY also asserted on the same cycle
dependency_graph.AXI_read: ARVALID precedes RVALID; RVALID stays asserted until ARREADY accepted and final RLAST transferred

signals.name: RF_P / RF_N
signals.purpose: Differential 2.4 GHz RF port to the antenna balun/match; O-QPSK/DSSS, half-duplex.

signals.name: XTAL_P / XTAL_N
signals.purpose: Reference crystal (16/32 MHz) for the frequency synthesizer / chip clock.

logical_channel_catalog.name: Physical channel (2.4 GHz)
logical_channel_catalog.meaning: One of 16 DSSS channels (11-26), 5 MHz spacing, Fc = 2405 + 5*(k-11) MHz, 250 kbps.

logical_channel_catalog.name: Beacon
logical_channel_catalog.meaning: Superframe-delimiting frame from the coordinator carrying GTS descriptors and pending-address list.

logical_channel_catalog.name: CAP (Contention Access Period)
logical_channel_catalog.meaning: Slotted-CSMA-CA contention window within the superframe.
